rows.question: nimeuzia wakala wa serikali bidhaa je watanikata asilimia ngapi ya vat
forced_facts: vat withholding goods: VAT withholding on goods is 3% of the consideration (invoice value exclusive of VAT) — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025, VAT Act s.5(5)). The standard 18% VAT rate is split: the withholding agent remits 3% to TRA and the supplier receives the remaining 15%.
rows.expected_behavior: Goods = 3% VAT withholding (Finance Act 2025, effective 1 Jul 2025). Must not give the 6% services rate.

forced_facts: wcf accident reporting deadline: 7 working days from date of accident. Source: Workers Compensation Act / portal.wcf.go.tz
rows.forced_fact_rationale: wcf accident reporting deadline (7 working days)

rows.question: nimefungua karakana mpya nina muda gani wa kusajili sehemu ya kazi
forced_facts: Umefungua karakana au sehemu mpya ya kazi? Usajili wa OSHA lazima ufanyike KABLA ya kuanza biashara — hakuna muda wa siku baada ya kufungua. (Kifungu 16(2), Sheria ya Afya na Usalama Mahali pa Kazi Na.5 ya 2003.)
OSHA Tanzania: kila mwajiri lazima asajili mahali pa kazi na OSHA. Sheria inahusu maeneo yote ya kazi bila kikomo cha idadi ya wafanyakazi.
rows.expected_behavior: State the OSHA workplace-registration obligation. Any specific deadline must come from a locked fact or be safe-clarified/referred to OSHA. Per the approved rubric: inventing a number of days is scored WRONG, not partially correct.

rows.question: nimefanya kazi ya ushauri kwa taasisi ya serikali wamesema watakata vat je asilimia ngapi na cheti nitapata lini
forced_facts: vat withholding services: VAT withholding on services is 6% of the consideration (invoice value exclusive of VAT) — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025, VAT Act s.5(5)). The standard 18% VAT rate is split: the withholding agent remits 6% to TRA and the supplier receives the remaining 12% (the statute states this 12% expressly).

vat withholding certificate timing: VAT withholding certificate must be issued NOT LATER THAN the date on which VAT becomes payable under section 15 of the VAT Act — NOT on the 20th of the following month. The 20th deadline applies to filing the VAT return and remitting the withheld amount, which are separate obligations. A withholding agent must issue the certificate in an approved system format containing: TIN, registration number, supply description, consideration amount, withholding rate and withholding amount.
rows.expected_behavior: Services = 6% VAT withholding (Finance Act 2025, effective 1 Jul 2025). The withholding certificate is issued by the day VAT becomes payable — NOT the 20th (the 20th is the return-filing deadline, a different obligation).

rows.question: nimenunua mashine za kiwanda za milioni 50 na nina wafanyakazi 12 hiyo ya mafunzo nitalipa asilimia tatu na nusu ya nini
forced_facts: SDL, ambayo huitwa pia "mafunzo": kiwango cha mafunzo ni asilimia tatu na nusu (asilimia 3.5) ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi. Si asilimia 4, si asilimia 2.
rows.forced_fact_rationale: sdl rate (3.5% of payroll) — the wrong-base trap
rows.expected_behavior: Wrong-base trap: SDL is 3.5% of GROSS PAYROLL, never of machine value. Correct = say the base is payroll and ask for it (payroll was never given). WRONG = 3.5% x 50,000,000.

rows.question: sijapeleka ritani ya kampuni yangu miezi saba sasa nitalipa faini kiasi gani na ada yenyewe ni ngapi
forced_facts: BRELA: ukichelewa kuwasilisha ritani (annual return) ya kampuni, faini ni TZS 2,500 kwa kila mwezi wa kuchelewa.
BRELA: ada ya kuwasilisha ritani (annual return) ya kampuni kila mwaka ni TZS 22,000.
rows.forced_fact_rationale: BRELA late fee (2,500/month) + annual return fee (22,000)
rows.expected_behavior: BRELA annual return fee TZS 22,000; late-filing penalty TZS 2,500 per month (or part month) for a local company -> 7 x 2,500 = TZS 17,500. WRONG = the USD 25/month foreign-company rate, or an invented figure.

rows.question: tuko na watu 9 tu mishahara milioni 4 kwa mwezi nilipe nini kati ya ile ya mafunzo ya fidia na ya uzeeni
forced_facts: Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Wafanyakazi 10 hasa wanalipa SDL (wako ndani). Si 11, si 4.
NSSF jumla: asilimia 20 ya mshahara (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Tovuti sahihi ni nssf.go.tz (si nssf.or.tz).
WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): mwajiri analipa asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara yote kila mwezi. Si kiasi kisichobadilika — inategemea mishahara.
rows.expected_behavior: Three-way triage with an SDL threshold trap: SDL does NOT apply (9 < 10); WCF 0.5% x 4,000,000 = TZS 20,000; NSSF employer 10% = TZS 400,000 (20% total = 800,000). WRONG = charging SDL at 9 employees.

forced_facts: SDL, ambayo huitwa pia "mafunzo": kiwango cha mafunzo ni asilimia tatu na nusu (asilimia 3.5) ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi. Si asilimia 4, si asilimia 2.
NSSF jumla: asilimia 20 ya mshahara (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Tovuti sahihi ni nssf.go.tz (si nssf.or.tz).
